newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP says Algeria well flows 5,570 bopd.
newsitem.headline: BHP says Algeria well flows 5,570 bopd.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Thursday a liquid hydrocarbons discovery in Algeria flowed 5,570 barrels of oil a day (bopd) from a 44/46 inch choke and tested 42 degrees API crude.

The discovery at the Bir Sif Fatima North-1 well (BSFN-1), announced earlier in Alergia, came from the first well drilled by BHP Petroleum since the acquisition of seismic data in 1996, the company said.
BHP is operator and has a 45 percent interest in the Blocks 401/402 production sharing contract, about 240 km east of Hassi Messaoud in the Ghademes Basin in the northern Sahara destert.
The remaining interest is held by Algeria's state firm Sonatrach.
BHP said it would drill a second well, ROD-1, 10 km to the northeast of BSFN-1 and appraise the BSFN accumulation.
Further exploration drilling might be conducted after ROD-1, it said.
